scope: Post-confirmation diagnostic; confirmation actors were previously opened, so this is not a new sealed benefit gate.
question: Does a renderer fitted with real audio outperform the same-capacity architecture fitted with a constant-zero audio stream on the same 2.0-second raster target?
comparison: Original AudioFiLM renderer versus a separately fitted AudioFiLM renderer whose audio input is zero for every development, validation, and confirmation example.
controlled_settings: Reuse the registered RAVDESS actor split, 64x64 target, seed 1701, architecture, AdamW settings, batch size 64, maximum 40 epochs, patience 6, validation-MAE checkpoint selection, and 240 confirmation targets.
primary_statistic: Constant-audio-trained MAE minus original aligned-audio MAE on each of the 240 registered confirmation targets; report paired and four-actor bootstrap intervals without a significance or practical-benefit gate.
